dos.title: Set up Safaricom M-Pesa immediately
dos.description: Kenya is virtually cashless for daily transactions; activating an M-Pesa account via a tourist SIM lets you pay anywhere via phone.

dos.title: Respect single-use plastic bag bans
dos.description: Kenya strictly enforces a world-famous total ban on single-use plastic shopping bags; customs will confiscate them at the airport.

dos.title: Follow safari guide ethical rules
dos.description: Never urge safari drivers to go off-road or approach wild animals too closely in Maasai Mara or Amboseli.

donts.title: Don't photograph government buildings or police
donts.description: Photographing state house, military installations, bridges, or police personnel is strictly illegal in Kenya.

donts.title: Don't smoke in public outdoor spaces in Nairobi
donts.description: Smoking in public streets or parks outside marked smoking zones is strictly fined by municipal council officers (Kanjo).

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants; safari driver-guides and camp staff expect daily tips ($10-15 per day per person) for their expertise.
